children: SAUDI INVESTMENT BANK - TO SELL 50% STAKE IN AMERICAN EXPRESS SAUDI ARABIA (AESA) FOR SAR 1,430.11 MILLION
SAUDI INVESTMENT BANK- SIGNING OF AGREEMENT WITH AMEX (MIDDLE EAST) TO AFFECT SALE OF BANK’S 50% SHAREHOLDING IN AMERICAN EXPRESS SAUDI ARABIA
SAUDI INVESTMENT BANK- TRANSACTION WILL BE SETTLED IN CASH
SAUDI INVESTMENT BANK- BOOK VALUE OF BANK’S INVESTMENT IN AESA AMOUNTED TO SAR 637.70 MILLION AS OF 30 NOVEMBER 2025
SAUDI INVESTMENT BANK- TRANSACTION REPRESENTS TERMINATION OF SHAREHOLDERS' AGREEMENT AND EXIT OF BANK FROM AESA
SAUDI INVESTMENT BANK- TRANSACTION EXPECTED TO RESULT IN A GAIN OF SAR 792.41 MILLION, BASED ON THE BOOK VALUE AS OF 30 NOVEMBER 2025
SAUDI INVESTMENT BANK- IN ADDITION, BANK WILL RECEIVE THE DEFERRED PURCHASE PRICE FOLLOWING THE COMPLETION OF TRANSACTION
SAUDI INVESTMENT BANK- PROCEEDS FROM THE SALE WILL BE UTILIZED TO SUPPORT AND STRENGTHEN THE BANK’S FINANCIAL POSITION
